destinations.rationale: Active Indian shortlist leader (CMP ₹2,251.60, BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO, stop ₹1,978.52); held at 0% in this SSWL-specific single-stock review so marginal cash stays 100% preserved pending portfolio-level sizing.
destinations.entry_condition: Cleared for portfolio-level consideration above ₹2,178.38 support with ₹1,978.52 structural stop.

destinations.rationale: Higher-ROCE (17.8%) and lower-leverage (0.19x D/E) auto-ancillary peer at CMP ₹2,540.20, but 35.14x TTM P/E offers only 0.43:1 asymmetry above its ₹2,498.47 stop.
destinations.entry_condition: Requires deeper valuation pullback below ₹2,150 before offering 1.5:1 upside.

primer: SSWL leads Indian automotive wheels (54% M&HCV share, 42% tractor share, 32%+ alloy mix) and posted record Q2 FY27 sales of ₹1,930 Cr (+61% YoY). Business quality remains CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL: pre-tax ROCE is 14.8%, adjusted leverage exceeds 2.5x, and a ₹1,400 Cr greenfield capex cycle is starting. At ₹567.40 (30.42x TTM P/E, weekly RSI 92.18), our Base Case value is ₹495.00 (-12.8%). New capital is REJECTED on VALUATION, while the 1-share Zerodha tracking stub stays on a hard ₹509.98 trailing stop.
